reviews.text: Took my 10 month old rottweiler for the two week board and train and we are extremely happy with the training. He obeys and listens to commands, is much more well-behaved and i can take him off leash with no problems. Highly recommend this trainer!

We actually didn't use ACDT but called him about some issues our 2 yo dut h Shepard was happening. He was upfront about what was likely going on and advised us that we should get her checked out by a vet before spending a bunch of money on  training, we really appreciate his upfront advice and forthright information.

I was overwhelmed with a new puppy when I found Alamo City Dog Trainers online. I took Alder, my puppy, to meet Abe and find out about the board and training programs Abe offers. After just a few minutes, I felt hopeful and less anxious about having a puppy.
Alder did the two week board and train with Alamo City Dog Trainers, and the change in his behavior has been amazing. Abe’s kennel and training facilities are at his home, and he treats the dogs as his own. When I went to pick Alder up, he was happy, excited and following commands! Alder had obviously been well cared for. Abe worked with the two of us before sending us both home to continue our training. I appreciate that Abe is available for additional help and that I can board Alder at his facility when I leave town. Abe’s pricing is competitive, but he offers what most training facilities don’t - payment plans! This option helped me, a retired teacher, get training for Alder that I knew I could not do on my own. Alder and I both had a great experience with Alamo City Dog Trainers!

Abe transformed our dog for us. We dropped off an insane puppy who didn’t listen unless bribed by treats. We got back a dog that knows commands without any incentive. He houses the dogs in a super nice climate controlled kennel with their own personal potty area. He is also a veteran and was very accommodating of my military schedule.

We definitely recommend Alamo City Dog Trainers! We dropped off our 10-month-old Newfiedoodle, Hazel, for their two-week training program, and it was completely worth it.
The before and after is incredible! Hazel came home more confident, well-behaved, and eager to listen. The trainers were professional, caring, and did an amazing job keeping us updated throughout the process.
We couldn't be happier with the results.

I had a really good experience with this dog training program. It was a two-week program, and I saw great results with my dog. It was fun being able to see the progress as the trainer posts daily videos showing the training.

After the training was completed, I really appreciated that he took the time to offer me a one-on-one training session. He walked me through exactly how he worked with my dog so I could continue reinforcing everything at home. That extra support made a huge difference and showed how much he genuinely cares about both the dogs and their owners.

I highly recommend this program to anyone looking for real results and a trainer who goes above and beyond!

We sent our dog, Oli, to Alamo City Dog Trainer for a two-week program and had a fantastic experience. It's always tough leaving our dog for that long, but it was clear he was well taken care of the entire time. We enjoyed the daily progress videos! We've seen a massive improvement since he's been back. We would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable, professional trainer.

Such an incredible dog training experience!! He took our stubborn 9 month German Shepherd and in two weeks taught him to follow commands and walk on a leash like a dream. Moose is still a wild 9 month old dog with plenty of personality, just has a few more manners now! If you’re looking to get some training for your dog, Alamo City Dog Trainers will exceed your expectations!

Abe did an incredible job training my bloodhound. It’s the only other place besides my house he gets excited to go to. Abe goes above and beyond, answering any questions about training and even offering refreshers. My boy went from scared and misbehaved to confident and well behaved. Loved the daily pictures while he was there boarding.

Abe is incredible! Our 6 year old golden retriever Gus was anxious, always pulling on the leash, and had altercations with other dogs. Now he is a completely new dog…listens to commands, is a joy to walk, and is much more relaxed. It has actually been fun to take him to restaurants and parks. Alamo City Dog Trainers is the best!

Super happy with the results. Took my lab in for board and train and got back a dog my wife and I can take everywhere. She’s a pleasure to walk, we can confidentially go for walks and she’s right by our side. Loved the facilities and setup for the dogs, we’ll be bringing her back for boarding when we need to go out of town.

Abe was awesome I brought my dog for 2 week board and train. He was able to get her to overcome anxiety and shes a totally new dog. He taught her multiple commands and hand signals and worked 1 on 1 with me to ensure I fully understood what shes learned and how to use them on my own .  He offers continuous support and tips for his clients that you wont find anywhere else. I recommend Him to all who want an awesome dog that can confidently go anywhere.

We boarded our 9 month old German Shepherd Dog for the two week board and train and were so happy. Abe uploaded daily videos and pictures showing his progress. We were looking for obedience and reactivity training and we definitely noticed a difference. I would definitely feel comfortable boarding our dog with him again!

Alamo City Dog Trainers offers a 10 day board and train and that's what we sent our 2 year old poodle to. It has been a couple of weeks since he finished his program and we are happy to report that he's been such a good boy since his training! Walks are now pleasant and less stressful, he listens when we are out in public, and his recall at the dog park with distractions has improved. During drop off Abe will show you where your dog will be staying and any doubt you had about safety and treatment of your pet will go out the window. We were pleased and very impressed with the dog's living quarters! Updates on social media were consistent and exciting to see our pets progress! At the end of the program Abe taught us how to use the E collar to its fullest potential and we've been enjoying our well behaved dog! Couldn't recommend Alamo City Dog Trainers enough. Local, reasonably priced, and most importantly effective. Thanks Abe!

If I could give more than 5 stars I definitely would! To take on a 3 year old rambunctious boxer is no easy feat, but Abe pulled it off successfully! Whiskey stayed with him for two weeks and she learned so much. I appreciate that he also took the time to "train us" when we picked her up. He's an amazing trainer, and I would definitely recommend him to anyone interested in training their dog.

We boarded our 2 year old poodle for the 10 day board and train Abe offers. It was the best decision we’ve ever made. Abe kept us posted through his social media accounts. We were able to follow along with Milo’s training. At pick up time he goes over everything he’s taught your dog, & is open to any questions you may have. I highly recommend Abe for your dog’s training. If I could do it again I would!

Sent Ruth (9 month Doberman) for training and I was skeptical about how she would do. She’s stubborn, scared and all around a pain - but I love her! She is a complete 180 from when I dropped her off for her 2 week board a train. I highly recommend Alamo City Dog Trainers!

We couldn’t be happier with our experience! Before training, our puppy was full of energy but struggled with listening and following commands. After the board and train program, we can see such a huge difference in his behavior, he’s calmer, more focused, and so much easier to manage at home and in public. Abe professional, caring, and really kept us updated throughout the process. It’s clear he truly cares about the dogs and wants to set them (and us) up for success. We’re so thankful for everything he has done and highly recommend him to anyone looking for real results!
One of the biggest challenges was Koda’s recall. He would just not come when asked. It’s now night and day. When I need him to focus and leave, he’s A LOT more attentive and responsive.

Nancy has been showing great results from her training! She went from being a very reactive dog to a focused and obedient dog. Alamo City Trainer guided us to a better and healthier dog-owner relationship and his work really helped Nancy become a confident doggie!

Great experience, we have a very high energy shepherd mix we enrolled in the two week board and train program.  Great results, and nearly two months later the lessons learned have stuck.  Highly recommend!

Nancy had the best 10 days of training! She went for behavioral and mannerism purposes and she has learned all the commands and is doing great with recalling all of them. He works with your dog one on one and gives them the time they need and will adjust differently to each and every dog and knows a lot about the breed of each dog and their natural born habits and works with them. Truly the best trainer and I couldn’t be more happier with results! I loved the daily updates and posts on social media to see how happy she was and how good her progress was coming along.

Great experience and excellent training!! Abe trained our 8-month puppy, and she's doing great! Excellent manners and recall, no more jumping, and so well- behaved. Thanks, Abe, for all of your hard work and dedication!!
Best dog training experience& loved the facility! Would recommend everyone I know to Abraham!

Alamo City Dog Trainers is THE BEST Trainer you could ask for and then some. My girl Tinta was pulling me all over the place, lunging at anything that moved, and was generally out of control. Abe treated my girl Tinta like she was his own from the beginning. He was kind, knowledgeable, patient (with both her and me!), and incredibly professional. After a 2 week boarding training with Abe, I can walk her and barely have to hold her leash! The commands she was trained on are easy to use. The constant picture and video updates for their "field trips" assured me she was in fantastic hands. I am forever grateful for Alamo City Dog Training and Abe for giving my girl the tools she needed to be successful and giving us the chance to enjoy the world without stress! Highly recommend them to anyone looking for training their fur baby.

Clyde is the first dog I’ve ever owned, and I was so nervous about handing him over to a trainer. Abe crushed it with my dog. The consistent photos gave me reassurance that my pup was not only in good hands, but happy having a chance to be out and about in parks for his training! My little guy went from an over- enthusiastic leash puller to a lil man who heels perfectly. He also made friends!! -Clyde really struggles to make friends, so it was awesome to see him find one in one of the other pups that was training with Abe. I would absolutely recommend this program for training if you’ve been struggling with your pup

I took my boy Rocket for the two week training and WOW i have never been more impressed. I honestly could tell that my dog was taken care of with the best care in the world!! I’ve never been more impressed with a dog trainer before. Constant photo and video updates on Facebook and instagram and the training performed was phenomenal. Communication was perfect and the minute I got Rocket back, he was a completely different and properly trained boy. His personality is still there but his listening skills and command training are on another level. I HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend Alamo City for your training needs. Rocket made some great dog friends and this truly helped with his separation anxiety with being away from me. I wish there was a way to give more than 5 stars. Exceptional service and training 1000%!

Alamo City Dog Trainers is the BEST! Our goldendoodle had a few issues with jumping on people and would not come to you for anything if you called her. After her 2 week board and train she is doing amazing! We can walk her without a leash and she stays right by us, and listens so well not jumping like she was. Absolutely recommended if you are looking for help with your pup!

Alamo City Dog Trainers is THE place to have your dog trained. Ensuring you and your best friend both have happy experiences together forever. Abe will diagnose your dogs personality and customize their training protocol to fit the required needs. We are thankful for the training and you will be too.

We took our pitbull Kota for the 2 week board and train and we are amazed by the results. We felt comfortable leaving Kota after meeting Abe (trainer) and seeing the space Kota would be living in. Kota now knows 9 commands and listens to us!!!! He is also still the happy, fun dog that we took but now has manners!

I had all but lost hope to train my stubborn Basset Hound. But I took him to Alamo City Dog Trainers and Abe worked with him and now he's a new dog ... heels, sits, stays, comes, down -- all the commands. ACDT is professional and effective -- highly recommend.

Thank you Abe for working with our dog Odin!  We have already seen a HUGE difference in his behavior and now he is fun to take out and go for walks and play with Odin!   We’re going to keep up with what we learned and I know Odin won’t forget!

We took Watney, our 3 year old Australian cattle dog mix, to Alamo City Dog Trainers to help get his high energy/anxiety under control and he came back so well trained.

Before training we weren't able to go on walks (or in public) with Watney because he was scared of most noises and barked at any animal that crossed our path. Now we love going on walks, visiting the deer and ducks in our local park with no issue. We've even been able to visit coffee shops and farmers markets with Watney with no issue, which is a dream come true.

I highly recommend Alamo City Dog Trainers if you're in a similar situation and need help. Abe is great with the dogs and he obviously knows what he's doing. It's been a game changer for our family.
This place worked wonders with our dog, we are so pleased with the training that was done. We can't thank you enough!!!

My husband and I recommend Alamo City Dog Trainers! We boarded our Doberman Macaroni for a 2 week training session. We had issues with Mac being stubborn and not wanting to listen, we wanted to take him out in public but were afraid that he would run off. Abraham was great with Mac and posted several updates of his training sessions via Instagram, facebook, and tiktok so we were happy to stay updated on his progress, Abraham took Mac out in public and were walking all over the place, Mac was very well behaved. On pick-up day, Mac was still his very happy go lucky self, his goofy demeanor had not changed at all, this made us very happy. Abraham was very patient with all our questions and walked us through the commands step by step, he let us know that Mac is very happy but that we must be more authoritative since Mac likes to test his boundaries of what he can get away with. The impact the training has had is amazing!!!

10/10 recommend. My dog had some issues with leash pulling, down, and come — and after 10s of training we already notice a huge difference. He’s much better at obeying his commands and we feel much better about taking him out in public, …
